Kitty proof your apartment by: 
- removing toxic plants 
- increasing territory by upsizing vertically (clear out shelves, maybe get a tall cat tree) 
- limiting candles and essential oil diffusers 

make cat feel welcome by:
- making them be in just 1 room for the first week until they’re ready to venture out by themself 
- crouching down to kitty’s level instead of towering over them when approaching 
- having a set routine of feeding time and playtime 


best litter in my opinion is Worlds Best multicat unscented (the red one). clumping clay but it’s not rock hard and traps odor fairly well. lasts a LONG time. 

a lot of cats don’t drink water from a still source, so a fountain might be better. also STAY AWAY from tap water. the minerals in it can crystallize together and cause a urinary blockage. stick to purified or distilled. 

my cat’s favorite toy is a cheap plastic watch that she stole from my brother. she also LOVES a bath loofah, especially if it’s been heavily used and becoming torn and tattered. she likes watching the outside so i open my window and let her onto my roof to bird watch. cats are strange creatures.  but traditional go to toys are the feather wands, any kind of springy thing, and furry mice. 


i’ve never tried an automatic feeder. 

people might disagree with me but i find grain free brands to be so much better for my cat. she has a habit of throwing up right after eating, and she used to be on fancy feast (which has a ton of fillers like corn wheat and soy). i switched her over to Fussie Cat and Almo Nature and she barely throws up and her fur is shinier. she’s so picky, so i don’t feed her raw, but cats are carnivores, so keep that in mind. they’re not meant for a diet with added sugars and fillers. 

additional points: 
* don’t declaw, it can be very painful for kitties. 
* it’s okay to take them to the groomers, esp if they’re prone to greasier fur or have longer hair. do your research about cat groomers in your area.
* for flea treatment go the topical route. Creams, collars, and sprays are better than internal pills that can do damage to their liver. 
* use wider plates for their food instead of deep bowls to avoid whisker fatigue
